what: The OWASP Wire as it was in its vault when this site was last released: headlines and primary links, each story's edition and dated corrections, the desk's latest release note. The live edition is the vault (eitf274v); this file is the fallback and the index for agents.

wire.title: The OWASP Wire
wire.description: Everything happening at and about OWASP: project releases, the GenAI Security Project, the Foundation and its board, events and chapters, and OWASP in the news. Each story is traced to its source and joined to the projects graph.

kind: first edition: two weeks of OWASP, with September context

latest_release.title: Correction to ow-09 and the source tiers: OWASP materials are open-licensed
latest_release.summary: The owner, a long-time OWASP leader, confirms that all OWASP materials are released under open licences. The 'All rights reserved' footer on the new owasp.org is treated as a template oversight, pending the Foundation's confirmation, and ow-09 says so. OWASP's own sources move to tier A (open, share-alike where stated).

changes.what: Context added from the wire's owner, a long-time OWASP leader: all OWASP materials are released under open licences, so the 'All rights reserved' footer on the new site is most likely a template oversight rather than a policy change. The question stands as a question to the Foundation, not a verdict; sources from OWASP are treated as open (tier A) in this vault.
